summary: Interest on a house loan payable outside India is not deducted from income from house property where no tax was paid or deducted on it and no one in India acts as the lender's agent.

routes.name: Interest payable in India, or taxed at source
routes.description: Deducted as any other interest on the house.

disqualifiers.description: Interest payable outside India with no tax paid or deducted and no agent in India.
